body.x: Cosmo participated in ‘2018 CES SHOWSTOPPERS’ held in Las Vegas on 9th (U.S. time standard) and introduced a smart helmet for cyclists.

Cosmo has manufactured a fixed stoplight on the back of the helmet to ensure the safety of cyclists. When a cyclist slows down, it automatically lights up and car drivers behind can notice quickly. The device with a built-in accelerometer and gyrometer automatically send a warning message via mobile application to family or friends when an accident occurs while riding a bike.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
